stories.title: DOJ asks for Supreme Court to intervene on California ballot demands
stories.summary: On the eve of the Nov. 3 election, the Trump administration is hoping the Supreme Court will reverse lower courts that rejected its request to order California to set aside the ballots of thousands of people it says are "likely" noncitizens.

stories.title: These CA Election Day rules could block news coverage of voting
stories.summary: Some California counties are issuing guidelines restricting the press from documenting Election Day proceedings at polling places in ways that appear to violate state statutes and the First Amendment. stories.title: Need more financial aid for college? This new law will make it easier to ask for it
stories.summary: A new California law will require colleges and universities to clearly inform students how to request additional financial aid if they believe their awarded amount is not enough. stories.title: Beware the ‘red mirage’ if California Republicans have an election night lead
stories.summary: Don’t be fooled by early election returns. It can take California weeks to tally votes, leading to “red mirages” and “blue shifts.”

stories.title: Counties’ Election Day rules may block news coverage of voting, civil rights groups warn
stories.summary: Some of California’s most populous counties are issuing guidelines restricting the press from documenting Election Day proceedings at polling places in ways that appear to violate state statutes and the First Amendment.

stories.title: San Onofre’s nuclear waste is stored on the beach: Will another community agree to take it?
stories.summary: San Onofre’s nuclear waste has been stored on a beach for years. This lawmaker wants to find a community willing to take it.

stories.title: The ‘affordability’ crisis is also a crisis of broken trust in the American Dream
stories.summary: “Affordability” is the gap between what things cost and what you can afford to spend, yes, but it’s more than that.

stories.title: Why school board members aren’t running for reelection: ‘A lot of disillusionment’
stories.summary: School board members cited a slew of reasons for not running for reelection, including distress over budget cuts and labor strife, immigration raids affecting schools and youth and an overall hostile political climate.

stories.title: Haley Stevens backs Mike Rogers. And, Gulf states brace for potential attack on Iran
stories.summary: Democrats in Michigan are considering their options after Haley Stevens endorsed GOP candidate Mike Rogers for Senate. And the Gulf states are bracing for a possible U.S. attack on Iran after the midterms.

stories.title: Two economists studied California's billionaire tax. They reached wildly different conclusions
stories.summary: What happens in California could shape how America taxes the superrich. But will its billionaire tax fill state coffers — or drain them?

stories.title: 6 things to watch for on election night
stories.summary: Some of the key storylines to watch will center around various voters groups that have soured on President Trump during his second turn out.

stories.title: When it comes to election pressure, this year's Georgia or Michigan could be anywhere
stories.summary: The districts that will decide control of the House and Senate next year are spread across the country. Voting officials in those places may face scrutiny and pressure they've never experienced.

stories.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
stories.summary: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?

stories.title: With students scarce, college admissions offices get friendlier, less intimidating
stories.summary: Colleges are trying to transform an admissions process that has often been daunting, secretive and stressful into an experience that's open, easier — and downright friendly.

stories.title: What Vance's midterm push reveals about his potential 2028 bid
stories.summary: Vance's delivery is different from the president's but his speeches contain plenty of MAGA DNA.

stories.title: Morning news brief
stories.summary: Democratic Rep. Haley Stevens endorses GOP candidate in Michigan race, key races remain close in last day before midterm election, Gulf states concerned about possible U.S. attack on Iran.

stories.title: UN's peacekeeping mission in disputed Western Sahara ends after 35 years
stories.summary: The U.N.'s long-running peacekeeping mission for the disputed Western Sahara ceased operations Sunday after 35 years. Once ruled by Spain, it is claimed by both Morocco and the pro-independence Polisario Front.

stories.title: California police union takes on a Supreme Court justice in new campaign
stories.summary: California's largest law enforcement union is urging voters to oust Supreme Court Justice Kelli Evans with a last-minute campaign before Election Day.

stories.title: Para que conste: El hombre de Fresno deportado por ICE tenía antecedentes de cruces ilegales
stories.summary: Según las autoridades federales, Luis Arreguin había sido deportado cinco veces antes de su reciente arresto por motivos de inmigración en el condado de Fresno.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta’s legacy is the generations of labor activists she inspired from the frontlines
stories.summary: Dolores Huerta was an inspirational role model, a militant who named and shaped the world, writes a UC Berkeley professor reflecting on the labor icon's legacy.
